Name: Avatar Aang the Last Airbender
Author: bananapipi
Description:
Currently, the mod character of Aang just wanders around Pelican Town and tells you about his friends. He'll tell you about how he's looking for Aapa, or how he's just stopping in between training.

You can find him in the mornings in front of Haley's house. 

In the future, I hope to bring all the Avatar characters to life in Stardew Valley and maybe create a skin so that you can choose an air bison as a pet. 

All artwork is done by me, and I hope to update my style and therefore his drawings. He is compatible with the updated version of SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Aang
Manifest.Description: Avatar Aang has stopped by in Pelican Town to take a break from training
